title: Looks nice, stays put, launders well, but is NOT waterproof
text: Looks nice, stays put, launders well, but is NOT waterproof. These covers actually stay put, even on my leather furniture. It's really quite amazing how they don't slip and slide even when our dog jumps around on them. When I used other things around the house to cover the couch, it was always bunched up, untucked and leaving furniture exposed. That never happens with these covers, even on the leather pieces I own. I haven't washed them yet, and so have no idea how well they will hold up or look after laundering. The one serious flaw is that they are not waterproof. Do not expect these to protect your nice sofa from getting stained by liquids.

product_metadata.title: Gorilla Grip Original Soft Sofa Protector, XL Oversized, 78" Seat Width, Patented Slip Resistant Durable Furniture Slipcover with Straps, Suede-Like Washable Couch Cover for Dogs, Kids, Pets, Brown
features: Slip Resistant Furniture Protector: finally, a protector engineered to stay in place; includes a slip resistant backing to help it stay put on fabric or even leather furniture; works great in busy homes with kids and pets; also features a thick, patent pending adjustable strap to help reduce the need for adjustments

Super Soft Suede: you’ll have to feel it to believe it; the protector features a soft top layer of luxurious suede like material that helps to keep you comfortable and cozy; thick material is so smooth

Perfect Fit for All Furniture: measure for the perfect fit; the sofa cover fits sofas with a seat width up to 78 inches; see the measuring guide for detailed measurements; enhance your entire living room with more sizes like loveseat, chair and recliner
More Protection: thick material helps to easily repel liquids, hair, crumbs and more from making messes on your furniture

Easy to Clean: machine washable for an easy clean; air dry only; we recommend washing before first use; do not use on furniture treated with additives, cleaners, or conditions; they may react with the backing and result in damage to your furniture; some materials are pre treated; check with furniture manufacturer and retailer before use
